description: Marks objects of a local session for check-in. Marking selects objects of YOUR session: it does not lock them for others, who only see them as marked in another local session, and an object another session also marked is a conflict to resolve before check-in. Object handles (positive integers) come from the `handle` fields of tia_local_sessions and tia_markings or from the tia_obj_* tools on the session's project; they die with the session. 1 to 200 distinct handles. Refused, nothing changed: an object that is not markable is 409 not_markable (details.objects); an object another session marked and this one has not is 409 marked_by_others unless allowConflict:true, which marks it anyway and lists it in `conflicts` (only when the human wants the conflict). An object this session already marked is skipped (already_marked); with nothing to apply the answer is 200 with applied:[]. Returns {action, session, applied, skipped, conflicts, states}. Undo with tia_objects_unmark. `session` is the name or the full path of an open local session (as listed by tia_local_sessions; the project path first, then the project name ignoring case) and may be left out when exactly one session is open: none open is 409 no_local_session, several open without `session` (or a selector that matches several) is 409 ambiguous_session (details.sessions lists index, name and path), an unknown one is 404 not_found. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (toApply, skipped, conflicts or the same refusal) WITHOUT marking. Nothing is ever checked in to the Project Server: check-in (CloseAndCommit) is not offered by any tool. Maps to POST /multiuser/localsessions/markings/mark {session?, handles, allowConflict?}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

allowConflict.description: default false; true marks an object another local session also marked and reports it in conflicts (only if the human wants a conflict)

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

handles.description: 1 to 200 object handles (positive integers) of objects of the local session

session.description: name or full path of the open local session (from tia_local_sessions); optional when exactly one session is open

name: tia_objects_mark
title: TIA — mark objects for check-in
